deposit.name: Round Top
deposit.notes: Low-grade, HREE-rich, acid-soluble fluorite; 90-95% inert quartz+feldspar.

methods.name: Dilute H2SO4 heap leach
methods.fit_to_host: high — yttrofluorite dissolves in dilute sulfuric at ambient T
methods.recovery: cited column/bucket: Y 61%, Dy 57.5% on 1/2–in crush (US 9,890,441); many tests 42–49% Y+HREE; USAR slide: up to 70% REE in columns (split unpublished)
methods.reagents: H2SO4 5–100 g/L tested; patent example ~8.3% v/v or 10 g/L bucket tests
methods.waste: acidic raffinate; F from yttrofluorite + cryolite/gearksutite/ralstonite; U/Th from soluble accessories; gypsum if lime neutralize
methods.scale: the designed path for this mountain; heap is how you treat a billion-ton low-grade rhyolite
methods.cost: order-of-magnitude: heap opex dominated by acid + neutralize + F/U/Th bleed; unknown without current PEA

methods.name: Dilute HCl leach
methods.fit_to_host: medium-high — patent allows HCl; chloride liquor feeds classic SX
methods.recovery: less Round Top column data than sulfate
methods.reagents: HCl; more expensive than H2SO4, easier SX
methods.scale: tank or heap; chloride heap is messier than sulfate
methods.cost: likely higher reagent than sulfate heap
methods.verdict: use if SX train wants chloride.

methods.name: PLS cleanup (F, Th, U)
methods.fit_to_host: required after yttrofluorite sulfate heap; F is structural in the Dy host, not an optional impurity
methods.recovery: US 9,890,441 claims two-stage contact can pull U/Th with little REE loss — cited as claim, not a published plant balance. F-cut recovery of Dy on this PLS: unknown
methods.reagents: options (not Round Top-proven): lime/gypsum sink, CaF2 precipitation, Al3+ to complex F, IX or SX for U/Th. Acid make-up after neutralize
methods.energy: low-moderate (pumps, pH control); not a roast
methods.waste: fluoride solids or bleed; U/Th concentrate (radiological); gypsum if Ca added to sulfate liquor
methods.scale: must sit in front of any mountain-scale SX; analog F circuits exist in phosphate/HF plants, not proven on this rhyolite PLS
methods.cost: unknown $/kg Dy. Experiment: closed-circuit column PLS assays for F, U, Th, Al, Ca vs Dy loss across the cut
methods.verdict: gate between heap and Dy/Y split. Skipping it contaminates extractant and product.

methods.name: Solvent extraction PC88A (EHEHPA)
methods.fit_to_host: after F/U/Th-cut leach; fights Y (adjacent, abundant at Round Top). β(Dy/Y) analog ~3.5 (Ahn 2017 PC88A synthetic) — not this PLS
methods.recovery: cited on monazite Y-concentrate (not Round Top PLS): ~93% Dy at ~97% Dy2O3 and ~95% Y at ~93% Y2O3 (Thakur 2000 mixer-settlers). Round Top sulfate stage map: unknown
methods.reagents: PC88A in kerosene; mineral acid strip (softer than D2EHPA); saponification common on chloride plants
methods.energy: mixer-settler pumping; adjacent-pair β of a few units implies many extract+scrub stages. INL analog mid/HREE circuit was ~30 stages. USAR public envelope: five SX circuits, >500 mixer-settlers at Wheat Ridge — extractant unpublished
methods.scale: industrial standard for Dy/Y polish; must be sized for Y>>Dy heap tenor, not a 60% Y2O3 monazite cut
methods.cost: capex in stages + organic inventory; opex extractant + strip acid. $/kg Dy on this PLS unknown
methods.verdict: workhorse Dy/Y split. Do not quote Thakur 97% as a Round Top plant number.

methods.name: Solvent extraction D2EHPA
methods.fit_to_host: stronger extractant than PC88A; less selective among HREE; harsher strip. Mixture with PC88A can raise Y/Dy β at low molarity (Mohammadi 2015, chloride synthetic)
methods.recovery: high extraction, harder strip; used in classic REE fractionation and in Thakur’s Y-concentrate flowsheets alongside PC88A. No public Round Top D2EHPA stage balance
methods.reagents: D2EHPA + kerosene; stronger acid to strip Dy than PC88A
methods.energy: similar SX train; more strip stages or stronger acid vs PC88A
methods.scale: proven bulk-HREE loader; a mountain sulfate PLS still needs a polish bank
methods.cost: similar SX capex; opex shifts toward strip acid. $/kg Dy unknown
methods.verdict: good for bulk HREE load; PC88A often cleaner for Dy polish.

methods.name: Solvent extraction Cyanex 272 / 572
methods.fit_to_host: weaker than PC88A; Batchu 2020: PC88A extracts Dy better; Cyanex 572 better mid/HREE vs Dy selectivity in some cuts
methods.verdict: candidate for a Dy/Tb or Dy/Y polish step, not the leach.

methods.name: Supported liquid membrane / ionic-liquid PIM
methods.fit_to_host: after F/U/Th-cut sulfate PLS; literature is chloride/nitrate or Y-rich HREE synthetics, not yttrofluorite heap liquor. Carboxylate ILs often prefer Y, which can be a Y-cutter rather than a Dy-first grab
methods.recovery: cited analogs only: Chen 2023 [N1888][CA12] HFRLM raised Y mole fraction 70.9% → >98.4%; CN114836638A example β(Yb/Y)~3.33. Dy/Y flux and recovery on Round Top sulfate+F: unknown
methods.reagents: IL or organophosphorus carrier in hollow-fiber / PIM / ELM; acid or water strip depending on IL. Module replacement when pores dump carrier
methods.energy: pumping through fibers; extract+strip in one module vs a mixer-settler cascade. Not a roast
methods.waste: spent modules; leaked IL/organic; F attack on pores is unmeasured here
methods.scale: 8 m² HFSLM pilots exist (Othman 2022 apatite analog). Not a replacement for a mountain heap. Candidate stage-count cutter or two-person skid
methods.cost: unknown $/kg Dy. Capex is modules + IL inventory; opex is flux collapse and replacement. Do not invent a plant number
methods.verdict: research wedge to cut stages. Not a heap. Not Wheat Ridge’s unpublished SX hall.

methods.name: Extraction chromatography / LN resin
methods.fit_to_host: lab-to-pilot polish of Dy after bulk SX or from dilute PLS
methods.recovery: high purity possible; capacity low vs SX
methods.reagents: impregnated organophosphorus resin; mineral acid eluent
methods.scale: poor as sole plant for mountain-scale PLS; good for oxide polish
methods.cost: resin $ high per kg Dy if used as primary split

methods.name: Oxalate precipitation
methods.fit_to_host: after separation; not selective among REE
methods.recovery: high if PLS is already Dy-rich
methods.verdict: how you make Dy2O3 after you already won the split.

methods.name: USAR Wheat Ridge flowsheet (opaque)
methods.fit_to_host: they produced 99.1% Dy2O3 from Round Top ore (Jan 2025, third-party ISO 17025); 2025 slide: SX pilot separated U, Th, Hf, Zr, HREEs; SEC 2026: five SX circuits targeting Dy, Tb, Y, Gd plus Hf/Zr
methods.recovery: not published as a plant figure
methods.scale: demo / R&D; public envelope >500 mixer-settlers; magnet plant is Stillwater OK, mine is Texas
methods.verdict: existence proof that Round Top ore can yield magnet-grade Dy oxide. Not a public recipe.
